$comment: Derived from src/App.jsx's real route table, src/data/*.js content maps, src/data/art/pages/*.json (the 72 scroll-captured route files), and HANDOFF.md/PROCESS.md's build history. Route-shadowing claims (About/Careers/Contact/Pricing/Changelog/Faq/TermsOfService components being unreachable) were confirmed live against the running dev server (localhost:5173) with Playwright, not just read from source.

meta.source: React Router table in src/App.jsx, rendering a local clone of clay.com

categories.SHELL: Site chrome present on (nearly) every route: nav bar and footer.
categories.HERO: Page-opening header block, live-built (not a scroll-captured plate).
categories.CAPTURED: A whole page body produced by the scroll-then-capture pass (scratchpad/scrollcap.js): sequential art+live-copy+live-video bands rendered by CapturedPage.jsx from a JSON file in src/data/art/pages/. Not a fixed section shape — the captured JSON itself defines the band sequence per route, including that route's own hero band.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: logo walls, marquees, customer quotes, the customer-story player.
categories.CONTENT: Live-built, data-driven body content shared across non-captured templates.
categories.INTERACTIVE: Stateful widgets, including interactive pieces spliced back into an otherwise-captured page.
categories.CONVERSION: Closing CTA bands and commerce content.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed overlay nav: wordmark, mega-menu (Product/Solutions/Company/Resources), search/⌘K control, Log in, and a CTA pair. Collapses to a drawer with an accordion below 768px.
shell.navbar.scope: Rendered once outside <Routes> in App.jsx — present on all 95 routes including the 404 catch-all.

shell.footer.description: CTA band plus a 5-column link grid.
shell.footer.scope: Rendered once outside <Routes> — present on all routes except the 3 a captured page's own JSON marks footerless (press, contact, demo, per HANDOFF.md); customer-story routes get an extra 80px spacer above it instead of a different footer.

hero.home.description: Full-bleed dark-green (#035D44) hero: headline, CLI-style typed demo, and CTA pair.

hero.product-live.description: Measured product hero (spec from data/productHeroes.js) or, for a product with no measured hero yet, the generic centred PageHero shape.
hero.product-live.scope: Used by template.product (11 routes) and template.product-captured is NOT this — those 3 render a captured hero band instead (see captured.page-body).

captured.page-body.description: The full sequence of a captured route's content bands, including its own hero band (the largest heading in the first two bands is tagged as the page's h1). Each band is either a static 2x screenshot 'plate' with live DOM copy/links overlaid at measured coordinates, or a live <video>/<gif>, per scrollcap.js's capture pass. This is one section id covering an entire page body because the real band sequence is data-defined per route in its own JSON file, not a fixed component shape shared across routes.
captured.page-body.scope: All 72 routes rendered by CapturedPage.jsx, across 12 templates — template.product-captured (3), template.use-case (11), template.solution (5) + template.solution-sticky (1), template.customer-story (31), template.customer-index (1), template.company (4), template.content-index (2) + template.faq-index (1), template.resource-captured (9) + template.resource-sticky (1), and template.pricing-legal-captured (3). Sum: 3+11+5+1+31+1+4+2+1+9+1+3 = 72.

interactive.faq-inline.description: An interactive accordion FAQ, spliced into a captured page's band sequence at its measured position, replacing a plate that would otherwise be a frozen screenshot of the same content. Not listed on any template's `sections` array (it doesn't apply to every route in either template it touches) — see each template's `$note` for which single route actually has it.
interactive.faq-inline.scope: Only the specific captured routes whose JSON has a matching src/data/art/pages-x/<key>.faq.json (per HANDOFF.md's 'interactive replacements' note) — /functions is flagged in HANDOFF §'Still open' as using the compact, non-interactive FAQ variant instead, i.e. NOT this section.

interactive.sticky-feature-panel.description: A sticky-image-plus-scrolling-text panel sequence, spliced into a captured page's band sequence, replacing a plate that would otherwise be frozen. Not listed on any template's `sections` array (it doesn't apply to every route in either template it touches) — see each template's `$note` for which single route actually has it.
interactive.sticky-feature-panel.scope: Exactly 2 real routes have a matching src/data/art/pages-x/<key>.sf.json file: /enterprise (template.solution-sticky) and /partners/solutions (template.resource-sticky) — each was split into its own single-route template rather than left inside its larger sibling template, since neither the other 5 solution routes nor the other 9 resource routes carry this splice.

interactive.prompt-builder.description: Tabbed, stateful prompt-input demo: clickable chips fill a controlled textarea.

content.flow-steps.description: 4-step tabbed flow cards with a layered-composite illustration per tab (coloured panel + textures + 2-3 UI screenshots at measured offsets) and a 9150ms auto-advance dwell.

content.feature-chapters.description: 4 alternating image/copy chapters, each with its own heading tint (navy/brown/olive/plum) and a looping feature video.

content.reps-visual.description: Stacked-record visual with a rotating logo-chip callout, on a looping feature video.

content.updates-grid.description: Conference/event promo banner plus a grid of update/post cards.

content.feature-rows.scope: template.product's intro band (11 routes) and any other live (non-captured) page that imports it.

content.how-to-band.description: A 3-step 'how to get started' card grid beside a heading/lead, defaulting to a generic 3-step copy if the product has no bespoke steps.
content.how-to-band.scope: template.product only (11 routes) — added per HANDOFF.md's QA pass note 'added the how-to band ... Fixes all 14' (that note predates 3 of the 14 products being superseded by captured pages; it now applies to the 11 that still render live).

content.faq-band.description: A sticky-heading FAQ accordion band, one item open at a time, all closed on load.
content.faq-band.scope: template.product (11 routes, via shared Faq.jsx) — the captured templates' FAQ content is either interactive.faq-inline (spliced) or part of captured.page-body (frozen plate).

proof.logo-marquee.description: Continuously scrolling customer-logo track: 2231px track, 15 columns x 3 rows, 24.0px/s (92.96s period). Not CSS animation — measured as rAF-driven on the original.

proof.logo-wall-static.description: A static grid of customer logos (not a marquee).
proof.logo-wall-static.scope: template.product's optional logo wall (only products whose productHeroes.js entry sets logoWall) and captured.page-body's own logo band on /customers ('Trusted by 500,000+', per HANDOFF.md's QA-pass note).

proof.customer-story-player.description: Stateful case-study video/quote player with an IntersectionObserver-gated autoplay.

proof.customer-voice-quotes.description: A 3-up grid of neutral placeholder customer quotes (attributed claims are deliberately not reproduced verbatim, per HANDOFF.md §4's convention).
proof.customer-voice-quotes.scope: template.product only (11 routes) — added per HANDOFF.md's QA-pass note 'added ... the customer-voice band. Fixes all 14' (now applies to the 11 still rendering live).

conversion.cta-band.description: Closing centred heading with a 'Start free trial' / 'Get a demo' button pair.
conversion.cta-band.scope: template.product's closing band (11 routes) and template.resource-simple's closing band (10 routes); equivalent closing bands inside captured.page-body on the captured templates are not a separate section id since their content/position is data-defined per route.

hero.left-plain.description: Left-aligned page hero (57.6/600/57.6/-2.304, 596 cap): eyebrow, title, sub, optional CTA pair. The one hero shape not implemented by a captured plate on any of its current routes.
hero.left-plain.scope: template.resource-simple (10 routes, with CTAs) and template.legal (1 route, /privacy, no CTAs — just title/sub).

content.card-row-3up.description: A 3-column grid of simple title/body cards on a tinted background; omitted entirely when a route's data has no cards.
content.card-row-3up.scope: template.resource-simple only, and only on routes whose data/simple.js entry sets cards.

content.legal-clauses.description: A sequence of heading+paragraph clause blocks plus a closing 'Contact us' line — no CTA band.

templates.name: Product (scroll-captured)
templates.$note: Same content family as template.product, but src/data/art/pages/{mcp,sculptor,sequencer}.json exist and App.jsx registers CAPTURED_KEYS routes before the PRODUCTS map, so these 3 render as captured plates, not via ProductPage.jsx, even though data/products.js still lists them. HANDOFF.md's '14 product routes -> ProductPage' table predates this and is imprecise for these 3 — verified live: /mcp, /sculptor, /sequencer set document.title from captured JSON (CapturedPage's behavior), which the ProductPage path does not do.

templates.name: Solution ("Clay for X")
templates.$note: 5 of these 5 come from data/usecases.js's SOLUTIONS map (gtm-ops/marketing/sales/startup) plus enterprise moved to template.solution-sticky; /clay-for-private-equity is the same page shape but defined ad hoc via data/simple.js's SIMPLE map instead — a real inconsistency in how the source data is organised, not an IA error.

templates.name: Customer story
templates.$note: 31 real captured routes (customers__* in src/data/art/pages/). The separate data/customers.js STORIES/STORY_LIST map only has 10 entries and feeds pages/Customers.jsx's CustomerStory component, which is shadowed by these captured routes for any slug that has a captured JSON file — same shadowing pattern as template.company. Long-form narrative copy on these routes is placeholder text at the original's exact character lengths (HANDOFF.md §4); short customer quotes stay verbatim with attribution.

templates.name: Company
templates.$note: src/pages/About.jsx, Careers.jsx, and Contact.jsx are real, substantial components that exist in the codebase but are unreachable at runtime: App.jsx registers each CAPTURED_KEYS route before the dedicated /about, /careers, /contact routes, and 'about'/'careers'/'contact' all have a matching src/data/art/pages/*.json file, so CapturedPage wins for all three paths. Confirmed live (not just read from source): localhost:5173/about sets document.title to "About | Clay.com" (CapturedPage's title-effect behavior) rather than leaving the default index.html title, which /privacy (a genuinely live, non-captured route) does leave unchanged. /careers's captured plate is also the one HANDOFF.md flags as carrying real named Clay employees' photos and bios baked into the plate, still unresolved as of HANDOFF.md's writing — see the project README for that caveat surfaced again.

templates.name: Content index
templates.$note: Same shadowing pattern as template.company: pages/Blog.jsx (BlogIndex) and pages/Simple.jsx's Changelog are still registered in App.jsx but shadowed by these 2 captured routes (/faq moved to template.faq-index).

templates.name: Resource / partner (scroll-captured)
templates.$note: 9 of data/simple.js's 21 SIMPLE entries are shadowed by a captured route at the same path (the 10th, /partners/solutions, moved to template.resource-sticky).

templates.name: Pricing / legal (scroll-captured)
templates.$note: pages/Pricing.jsx (plans + comparison matrix) and the /terms-of-service Legal instance are both shadowed by captured routes. Confirmed live: localhost:5173/pricing renders zero <table> elements and carries data-lazy attributes (CapturedPage's video-lazy marker), where a live Pricing.jsx render would show the comparison matrix HANDOFF.md describes as 'now inline'.

templates.name: Resource / partner (live-built)
templates.$note: The 11 of data/simple.js's SIMPLE entries with no matching captured-route path, minus /clay-for-private-equity (which belongs to template.solution by content shape, not this generic resource shape) = 10 routes actually rendered by the generic Simple.jsx component.

templates.name: Legal (live-built)
templates.$note: The one Legal-component route with no captured-route shadow. Confirmed live: localhost:5173/privacy keeps the default document title ("Clay | Build systems to grow revenue") rather than setting one from captured JSON, unlike every shadowed route above.

templates.name: Solution with sticky-panel splice
templates.$note: Same content family as template.solution, split out because it is the one solution route with a real interactive.sticky-feature-panel splice (pages-x/enterprise.sf.json) — a genuinely different page shape from its 5 siblings, not an arbitrary split.

templates.name: Resource/partner with sticky-panel splice
templates.$note: Same content family as template.resource-captured, split out because it is the one resource route with a real interactive.sticky-feature-panel splice (pages-x/partners__solutions.sf.json).

templates.name: FAQ index
templates.$note: Same content family as template.content-index, split out because /faq is the confirmed route with a real interactive.faq-inline splice (pages-x/faq — per HANDOFF.md, /functions explicitly uses a non-interactive FAQ variant instead, so it stays out of this template).
